**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is experiencing issues with the Wi-Fi signal in their bedroom.
- [FACT] The user has an Asus RT-AC68U router.
- [FACT] The router is located in a central spot in the living room.
- [FACT] The bedroom is about 20 feet away from the router, with a couple of walls in between.
- [FACT] The user has a range extender in the living room to help with coverage.
- [FACT] The user has a laptop and a smart speaker connected to the Wi-Fi in the bedroom.
- [FACT] Both the laptop and smart speaker experience slow speeds and occasional disconnections.
- [CHANGE] The user has tried restarting the router, but it doesn't seem to make a difference.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested moving the router to a higher location to improve signal broadcast.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended trying to optimize the placement of the range extender by moving it closer to the bedroom.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised checking for channel interference using tools like Wi-Fi Analyzer to identify the least crowded channel.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested setting up Quality of Service (QoS) to prioritize traffic to the user's laptop and smart speaker.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended updating the router firmware to improve performance and range.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that if issues persist, the user might consider upgrading to a mesh network system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a list of apps and tools for monitoring and optimizing Wi-Fi network performance, including Wi-Fi Analyzer, NetSpot, Wireshark, GlassWire, Network Analyzer, Speedtest.net, and router-specific apps.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant confirmed that most of the mentioned tools can help monitor the performance of the range extender.
- [FACT] The user is a smart home enthusiast and can control smart bulbs using voice commands with their Amazon Echo Show.
- [EVENT] The user plans to try moving the router to a higher location and updating the firmware.
